definitions.gout: a disease in which defective metabolism of uric acid causes arthritis, especially in the smaller bones of the feet.
definitions.group: a number of people or things located, gathered, or classed together.
definitions.grout: a mortar or paste for filling crevices, especially the gaps between wall or floor tiles.
definitions.grunt: (of an animal, especially a pig) make a low, short guttural sound.
definitions.input: what is put in, taken in, or operated on by a process or system.
definitions.outgun: have more or better weaponry than.
definitions.outing: a short trip taken for pleasure.
definitions.outro: the concluding section of a piece of music or a radio or television programme.
definitions.outrun: run or travel faster or further than.
definitions.pour: flow or cause to flow in a steady stream.
definitions.pout: push one's lips or bottom lip forward as an expression of petulant annoyance or in order to make oneself look sexually attractive.
definitions.punt: a long, narrow flat-bottomed boat, square at both ends and propelled with a long pole.
definitions.rout: a disorderly retreat of defeated troops.
definitions.rung: a horizontal support on a ladder for a person's foot.
definitions.runt: a small pig or other animal, especially the smallest in a litter.
definitions.tour: a journey for pleasure in which several different places are visited.
definitions.turn: move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis.
definitions.turnip: a round root with white or cream flesh which is eaten as a vegetable and also has edible leaves.
definitions.unit: an individual thing or person regarded as single and complete, which can also form part of a larger whole.
definitions.unto: expressing direction or position in relation to a location, point, or condition.
definitions.upon: physically in contact with and supported by (a surface).
definitions.uproot: pull (a plant, tree, etc.) out of the ground.
